info.title: RecruitmentEdge API
info.description: The tenant API (SaaS-6). A credential is issued by a member holding integrations.manage, acts as that member in that organisation only, and is limited to its scopes; every request re-checks the member's access, the organisation's status and its api.access entitlement. Tokens: `re_<key id>_<secret>`, shown once. Rate limits per credential and per organisation (429 with Retry-After). No request names an organisation: the credential decides it.

post.summary: Submit an applicant to a live job posting
post.description: The career site's intake: duplicate detection (a probable duplicate is held for review, 202), consent, notifications. Runs once per Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key and body replays the first response (header Idempotent-Replayed: true); the same key with a different body is refused (422). The credential's owner must be allowed to add candidates and see the posting's requisition.

202.description: Held as a probable duplicate for review

400.description: Malformed JSON, or a missing or invalid Idempotency-Key

404.description: Not found, or not visible to the credential's owner

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed

422.description: Validation failed, unknown query parameter, Idempotency-Key reused with a different body, or the posting is closed

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked credential

403.description: Scope, permission, entitlement or organisation status refuses the request

post.description: Authenticated by RE-Signature, not a credential. Verified, stored once per sender event id, acknowledged, then processed on the queue as the connection. Events: application.submitted (data.job_posting_id, data.applicant as ApplicantInput).

200.description: Duplicate of an event already accepted (not processed again)

400.description: Malformed JSON, or a missing or invalid Idempotency-Key

401.description: Signature missing, invalid or older than 5 minutes

403.description: The endpoint is disabled, or the organisation is not active or not entitled

422.description: Body lacks a string id or type

post.description: A candidate was added. data: object, id. Headers: RE-Signature (t=…,v1=… — HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body" with the endpoint's secret; two v1 values while a rotated secret overlaps), RE-Event-Id, RE-Delivery-Id, RE-Event-Type. Answer 2xx within 10 s; anything else is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 12 h, then the delivery fails. Redirects are not followed.

An application was created. data: object, id, candidate_id, requisition_id, job_posting_id, stage, status, origin_channel. Headers: RE-Signature (t=…,v1=… — HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body" with the endpoint's secret; two v1 values while a rotated secret overlaps), RE-Event-Id, RE-Delivery-Id, RE-Event-Type. Answer 2xx within 10 s; anything else is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 12 h, then the delivery fails. Redirects are not followed.

An application moved stage. data: object, id, candidate_id, requisition_id, previous_stage, stage, previous_status, status. Headers: RE-Signature (t=…,v1=… — HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body" with the endpoint's secret; two v1 values while a rotated secret overlaps), RE-Event-Id, RE-Delivery-Id, RE-Event-Type. Answer 2xx within 10 s; anything else is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 12 h, then the delivery fails. Redirects are not followed.

A requisition changed status. data: object, id, previous_status, status. Headers: RE-Signature (t=…,v1=… — HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body" with the endpoint's secret; two v1 values while a rotated secret overlaps), RE-Event-Id, RE-Delivery-Id, RE-Event-Type. Answer 2xx within 10 s; anything else is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 12 h, then the delivery fails. Redirects are not followed.

key.description: Key id only; the secret is never shown again

ApplicantInput.description: Other fields are ignored — nothing else about a candidate or application can be set through intake.

id.description: The sender's event id; one event per id per connection
Event id (evt_…); the same on every attempt and replay — deduplicate on it

data.description: Identifiers and states only — fetch details through the API
